text:
emma: Quick sync — we're prepping a customer vignette with Kairos (payments fintech). Need to record a 20–30m interview next week, collect a short quote, get legal signoff, and slot them for a demo webinar on Apr 14. Who can pick up what?

raj: Happy to join. Can we make sure the story includes concrete numbers — latency improvement, cost delta, model variant used? I can pull metrics.

claire: I'll own recording + asset checklist. @emma send the intro email and 3 suggested questions and I’ll build the recording invite. Also need embargo date.

emma: Draft intro + Qs here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (internals) — suggested Qs: 1) What problem were you solving? 2) Baseline vs today numbers (latency/cost/throughput). 3) Integration: time to ship + ops changes. Embargo: publish after webinar (Apr 14).

jordan: Confirmed — webinar slot Apr 14 11:00am PT on the calendar. Need slides by Apr 7. @raj can you do 2 slides (metrics + quote)?

legalbot: LEGAL CHECK: We need a signed customer quote/release form + any redaction requests from Kairos. Template: /legal/templates/customer_release_v1.docx. Please route signed copy to legal@redwood.com within 5 business days.

claire: Got it. I'll send the release and an asset permission form. Do we have permission for logo use?

emma: Kairos indicated logo + name ok in initial outreach but will reconfirm on the call. They requested removal of PII and exact pricing numbers from public quote.

jordan: Webinar flow suggestion: 1) 8–10 min demo, 2) 8–10 min customer interview, 3) 10 min live Q&A. Demo owner: @raj? Keep demo <=12m.

raj: I'll prep metrics: latency down ~40% on 2k-token streams after batching + cache; inference unit cost down ~28% with quantized model. Draft quote for customer review: "Redwood cut our inference cost and made latency consistent at peak."

legalbot: That wording should be customer-approved. Please include exact approved text in the signed release and CC customer's legal: legal@kairos.com.

leah: I can coordinate with Kairos for scheduling. Pinged their PM, they proposed Wed 10am or Thu 2pm — will confirm by EOD.

emma: Action items: @leah schedule interview and confirm logo permission; @raj prepare 2 slides + metric notes; @claire send release + recording invite; @legalbot track approvals. I'll draft blog + social snippets after transcript. :rocket: Thanks everyone — small huddle tomorrow 10am to finalize prep.
